Master Ao Vivo é o sinal enviado à trans: Live Master is the signal sent to the stream. It includes the playlist, Cart Wall, auxiliary inputs, and microphone. Monitoring sends that signal to the selected output and has its own level. Lowering Live Master also lowers what you hear; lowering Monitoring alone does not affect the stream. No modo automático, o RadioStudio analis: In automatic mode, RadioStudio analyzes the intro and outro audio levels and silent sections, chooses the overlap duration, and applies a constant-power fade curve. The Mix limit sets the maximum overlap (0 = up to 8 s); up to 1.2 s of silence at the start can be skipped. Analysis runs in the background; if unavailable, a safe transition is used. Without automatic mode, the times above remain fixed.
